name: @fx/notify
description: D#7 DP12b-2: email for decision asks. The Resend transport (HTTPS to the net-guard validated address, fixed timeout, errors reduced to a fixed code), the email text (fixed copy, counts and an Inbox link, never question text) and notifyAsks, which batches due asks into one email per account per 15-minute window. Ships OFF until RESEND_API_KEY and NOTIFY_FROM are set.
